question: An engineer must perform an initial configuration of VXLAN and MP-BGP EVPN on the Cisco Nexus 9000 Series platform. The underlay must be OSPF, and the VTEP must run with distributed default gateway on a VLAN interface. Which command set must be applied to meet these requirements?
options:
NX9K(config)# feature nv overlay
NX9K(config)# feature vn-segment-vlan-based

NX9K(config)# feature bgp -

NX9K(config)# nv overlay-evpn -

NX9K(config)# feature ospf -
NX9K(config)# feature interface-vlan

NX9K(config)# feature nv overlay

NX9K(config)# feature bfd -
NX9K(config)# feature vn-segment-vlan-based

NX9K(config)# nv overlay-evpn -

NX9K(config)# feature ngmvpn -

NX9K(config)# feature ospf -

NX9K(config)# feature nv overlay

NX9K(config)# feature bfd -
NX9K(config)# feature fabric forwarding
NX9K(config)# feature vn-segment-vlan-based

NX9K(config)# nv overlay-evpn -

NX9K(config)# feature ospfv3 -

NX9K(config)# feature nv overlay

NX9K(config)# feature bgp -

NX9K(config)# feature bfd -

NX9K(config)# feature ngmvpn -

NX9K(config)# feature ospf -
NX9K(config)# feature interface-vlan
theory: A standard VXLAN BGP EVPN deployment on Nexus 9000 requires several independent features enabled together: feature nv overlay turns on the NVE/VTEP infrastructure, feature vn-segment-vlan-based lets VLANs map to VNIs, feature bgp plus nv overlay-evpn brings up the MP-BGP EVPN control plane, feature ospf enables the chosen underlay routing protocol, and feature interface-vlan is required because a distributed anycast gateway needs SVIs configured on every VTEP to answer for the same shared gateway IP/MAC. Omitting interface-vlan, as some distractor answers do, would make it impossible to build the VLAN-interface-based anycast gateway the requirement calls for. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 3 — VXLAN EVPN Feature Prerequisites)
